summary: Defines BackendProfile, the database subclass of mountainash_settings.profiles.Profile that emits configuration only and carries no auth methods, and UrlParts, a frozen credential-free URL skeleton (scheme, database, host, port, path, query). BackendProfile.to_url_parts() builds UrlParts from the class __spec__ connection_string_scheme and the HOST/PORT/DATABASE fields, raising NotImplementedError for backends with no URL form.
extension_points: Per-backend profiles may override to_url_parts() (MotherDuckBackendProfile does).
Per-backend profiles may declare __adapters__ to reshape driver kwargs; the hook is resolved by mountainash_settings Profile.
lifecycle_notes: Auth is applied by core.factories (ConnectionFactory), never by BackendProfile; UrlParts is the L1 skeleton that the factory renders with credentials.
documentation_hooks: Config/auth separation: BackendProfile is credential-free; credentials arrive as an AuthProfile at connect time
risks: CLAUDE.md describes a ConnectionProfile with to_driver_kwargs()/to_connection_string(); neither the class name nor those methods exist here.
